title: Robot camera
status.waitingClaim: Open the address printed by the agent in its terminal.
status.agentLost: The agent stopped answering. The camera is off.
status.channelGone: The channel no longer exists. Ask the operator to check the robot.
claim.used: This address was already used. Ask the agent for a new one.
claim.expired: This address has expired. Ask the agent for a new one.
claim.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Ask the agent for a new address.
camera.notFound: No camera found: check that the webcam is attached.
camera.busy: The camera is busy: close the other applications.
error.unauthorised: This page is no longer authorised. Ask the agent for a new address.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment.
error.endpoint: AWS returned a signalling endpoint outside the expected region or protocol.
error.sdk: The video SDK is missing or not the pinned version. Build the video page again.
error.localDescription: The browser did not produce a local description for the connection.
